errors.what: First version of the rule extended any trace that stopped at a line, before the tail tests; on 113 tuning pieces it made 130 new tails and lost 8 correct liquescents.
errors.fix: Narrowed over three more tries (move only an accepted tail's end; then require the small note to straddle the line). All four tries recorded in eval/hook-on-line-check.md.

errors.what: A drawn-page test with the hook ending flush on the line did not reproduce the real failure (the real one needs a line measured thicker than its ink); a drawn epiphonus in that set-up was not found as a tail at all.
errors.fix: Test builds the staff by hand with the line's measured extent widened, and covers two cephalicus shapes; the epiphonus direction is covered by a real tuning case (3550).
